description: A third-party shortcode-to-emoji plugin may be registered on the Markdown engine before the slide-extension hook is applied. When slide mode is active the hook overrides the emoji renderer so emoji are emitted through the slide engine's own emoji renderer, marked with a distinguishing wire-format attribute; when slide mode is inactive the original emoji renderer is left untouched and that marker is absent. These boundary scenarios vary the emoji shortcode and exercise the case where slide mode is active but no third-party emoji plugin was registered. The input supplies the Markdown source and optionally registers the emoji plugin; output reports whether the slide engine's emoji marker is present.
